title: Singular Limits for Three-Dimensional Global Minimizers of Ginzburg--Landau-Type Functionals: Uniform Estimates and Singular Sets
summary: We study the asymptotic behavior of global minimizers of a Ginzburg--Landau-type functional with general compact vacuum manifold $\mathcal{N}$ on bounded domains in $\mathbb{R}^3$, in the regime where the energy grows at a logarithmic rate. We show that the normalized energy measures converge, up to a subsequence, to a measure supported on a finite union of closed line segments connecting prescribed singularities on the boundary.
